company_description:
Factory area:located in Zhenjiang City, Jiangsu Province (close to Shanghai)
4 automatic production lines equipped with 20 sets of professional production equipment
3 full-time R&D engineers specializing in RF structure optimization and material process improvement, capable of generating accurate CAD drawings within 2 hours
5 full-time QC inspectors implementing full-process quality control
Provide authoritative factory inspection reports with videos, 360° panoramic views and VR live streaming, certified by TUV
Rheinland Professional assembly line design ensures product quality and production efficiency
More than 1,800 product types; some products can be shipped on the same day at the earliest, and bulk orders can be delivered within 15 days
Own a variety of cutting-edge products with exclusive design and manufacturing
Adopt modular design to achieve rapid response, supporting foreign trade orders with "small batches, multiple styles and short lead times"
Full-process automated encapsulation and packaging, realizing full-link automation from manufacturing to delivery with high capacity utilization
High product qualification rate; professional testing equipment guarantees product quality
Integrate production, inventory and sales data via professional software to achieve real-time monitoring and automated processes
Optimize logistics and distribution routes; professional logistics team handles customs declaration, foreign exchange settlement and other procedures
Formulate reasonable production plans and dynamically allocate human and equipment resources to ensure on-time order delivery
Core partner of many Fortune Global 500 enterprises
Solve the loss and interference problems in high-frequency signal transmission, improving the stability and reliability of
communication systems
Meet customized requirements for multiple scenarios; support OEM/ODM design and rapid prototyping to shorten customers' product development cycles

company_faqs.question: Will you guide the use and installation?
company_faqs.answer: Of course, we will provide technical support and remote guidance throughout the process.

company_faqs.question: What payment methods do you support?
company_faqs.answer: Common payment methods include: T/T,D/P D/A,MoneyGram,Credit Card,PayPal,Western Union,Cash,Escrow.

company_faqs.question: Can you do design for us?
company_faqs.answer: Yes, we do OEM and ODM service. We have good experience development.

company_faqs.question: I don't know what type of connector/cable I need?
company_faqs.answer:
Don't worry, you can send us photos or specifications of your product, and we will have professional
engineers to follow up. We can also make samples and customize products.
